operators.name: custom_sigmoid

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: supports strides (contiguous or non-contiguous); must handle input stride [3145728, 1048576, 512, 1]

semantics: Supports strided input; kernel must use correct strides to access elements.
Output tensor has same shape, dtype, device, and stride as input (contiguous output preferred).
No broadcasting or reduction; pure elementwise.

operators.name: custom_instance_norm2d

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: supports strides (contiguous or non-contiguous); must handle input stride [3145728, 1048576, 512, 1]

semantics: For each sample in batch and each channel, compute mean and variance over spatial dimensions (H, W).
Supports strided input; kernel must compute per-instance statistics using correct strides.
Output tensor has same shape, dtype, device, and stride as input (contiguous output preferred).
eps is passed as a scalar double to launcher; kernel converts to float as needed.
Element-wise sigmoid activation on input tensor x.
Input shape [16,3,2048,512], dtype float32, device cuda.
For each (N, C) pair, compute mean and variance over spatial dimensions (H, W).
Output shape identical, dtype float32, device cuda.
